purpose: Canonical PI3K/PI3K-AKT-mTOR pathway gene panel used to compute a pathway z-score for TCGA-OV prognostic Cox (W1/W2) and platinum-response predictive analysis (W3). Fixed BEFORE analysis to avoid post-hoc gene cherry-picking.

scoring_notes.score_definition: Pathway activation z-score = mean of per-gene mRNA median z-scores for core_activating_axis genes MINUS mean z of negative_regulators (directional pathway-activity score). A second, simpler 'unsigned mean-z of all panel genes' is also computed as a sensitivity check.
scoring_notes.rationale: PTEN/TSC1/TSC2/STK11/PIK3R1 loss ACTIVATES the pathway, so their z enters with a negative sign in the directional score. Reported alongside the unsigned score for transparency.

provenance: Canonical PI3K-AKT-mTOR pathway members (KEGG hsa04151 / oncogenic PI3K signaling); panel committed as a pre-registration receipt for this validation run.
